# mic-hifi

> Local, real-time USB microphone processing on Linux/PipeWire, exposed as a virtual microphone: high-pass, levelling (lifts whispering), compression, DeepFilterNet3 noise suppression, gate, tone characters, multiband dynamics, limiter, loudness targets (−23 / −16 LUFS), optional GPU "quality" path (MossFormer2) and pitch shift. Audio never leaves the machine. Apache-2.0. Tested with the Nor-Tec streaming mic (USB ID 3206:1278) on Fedora 44, PipeWire 1.6.8.

Key facts for agents: the processing chain is defined only in `tools/chain.py`; the PipeWire config is generated by `tools/gen_conf.py` (never edit the generated file); the microphone is selected with `bin/mic device`; the panel runs on 127.0.0.1:8767. Measured on one machine and one microphone; settings are not verified by ear. The UI is in Turkish.

## Code
- [tools/chain.py](tools/chain.py): single definition of the processing chain
- [tools/gen_conf.py](tools/gen_conf.py): generates the PipeWire filter-chain configuration
- [console/server.py](console/server.py): local web panel API
- [bin/mic](bin/mic): command-line entry point (status, device, ab, console, enhance)
- [tests/verify.py](tests/verify.py): verification on the live chain
